issues.legal_issue: Sale deeds offered to establish market value cannot be relied on when their execution and consideration are unproved and the circumstances undermine their reliability.
material_facts: The claimants relied on sale deeds for small plots, including plots of one kanal and plots of five bighas.
None of the persons connected with the sale deeds was examined.
There was no proof that consideration passed or of the circumstances in which the deeds were executed.

The court considered cultivation of a one-kanal plot uneconomical and found that villagers could know of the impending acquisition before formal publication of the notification, creating a possibility that the deeds were brought into existence to inflate value.
issues.conclusion: The sale deeds were inadmissible and could not be considered in determining market value.
issues.legal_principle: In an appeal concerning land-acquisition compensation, sale documents whose execution and consideration are unproved and whose surrounding circumstances cast doubt on their genuineness cannot be relied on as evidence of market value. The court referred to the possibility of knowledge of acquisition before publication under Section 4(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894. No earlier case was relied on for this ruling.

rule.if: land_acquisition_compensation_appeal and sale_parties_not_examined and sale_consideration_and_circumstances_unproved and sale_plots_uneconomic_for_cultivation and acquisition_known_before_formal_notice

predicates.land_acquisition_compensation_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal concerning compensation for acquired land.
predicates.sale_parties_not_examined: The persons connected with the relied-on sale transactions were not examined.
predicates.sale_consideration_and_circumstances_unp: There was no proof that consideration passed or of the circumstances in which the sale transactions were executed.
predicates.sale_plots_uneconomic_for_cultivation: The plots covered by the sales were too small to make their purchase economical for cultivation.
predicates.acquisition_known_before_formal_notice: The circumstances indicated that the impending acquisition was known before formal publication of the acquisition notice.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerning land-acquisition compensation involves unexamined sale parties, unproved transaction details, uneconomical plot sizes, and knowledge of impending acquisition before formal notice, the sale documents are excluded from the market-value assessment.

issues.legal_issue: A finalized valuation for comparable land in a neighboring area may support the market-value determination when the land was acquired for the same purpose and no material distinction is shown.
material_facts: Land in a neighboring village had been acquired for the same purpose.
A prior valuation for that land had become final and provided different rates for different categories of agricultural land.
The acquiring authority could not identify a distinction between the relevant land and the neighboring land.
The court also referred to state sale instances and upheld the compensation determination, including treating the relevant Chahi and Nahri land alike.
issues.conclusion: The High Court was justified in relying on the neighboring-area valuation together with the state sale instances, and the compensation determination was upheld.
issues.legal_principle: In determining compensation for acquired land, a finalized valuation of land in a neighboring area acquired for the same purpose may be used as a judicial instance when no relevant distinction is shown, and may be considered with other sale instances. No earlier case was cited for this ruling.

rule.if: land_acquisition_compensation_appeal and neighboring_land_acquired_for_same_purpose and neighboring_valuation_finalized and no_material_difference_shown and state_sale_instances_available

predicates.land_acquisition_compensation_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal concerning compensation for acquired land.
predicates.neighboring_land_acquired_for_same_purpo: Land in a neighboring area was acquired for the same purpose as the land under assessment.
predicates.neighboring_valuation_finalized: The valuation determined for the neighboring land had become final.
predicates.no_material_difference_shown: The acquiring authority did not establish a material difference between the lands being compared.
predicates.state_sale_instances_available: Sale instances produced by the acquiring authority were available for consideration.

issues.definition: When a compensation appeal concerns land comparable to neighboring land acquired for the same purpose, the neighboring valuation is final, no material difference is shown, and state sale instances are available, the comparable valuation supports the compensation determination.

issues.legal_issue: A judgment from another proceeding that is not part of the record and has not been brought into evidence cannot be considered merely because an application to introduce additional evidence has been filed.
material_facts: The claimants relied on a judgment in another case concerning land in a neighboring village.
That judgment was not part of the record and had not been brought on record in the appeal.
An application under Order 41, Rule 27 of the Code of Civil Procedure was filed in relation to the judgment.
issues.conclusion: The judgment in the other case could not be considered.
issues.legal_principle: In an appeal, a judgment from another proceeding that is not part of the record and has not been admitted into the record cannot be considered merely on the basis of an application under Order 41, Rule 27 of the Code of Civil Procedure. No earlier case was relied on for this ruling.

rule.if: land_acquisition_compensation_appeal and external_judgment_not_in_record and external_judgment_not_brought_on_record and additional_evidence_application_filed

predicates.land_acquisition_compensation_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal concerning compensation for acquired land.
predicates.external_judgment_not_in_record: The judgment relied on was not already part of the appellate record.
predicates.external_judgment_not_brought_on_record: The judgment relied on was not admitted or otherwise brought into the appellate record.
predicates.additional_evidence_application_filed: A party filed an application seeking to introduce additional evidence relating to the judgment.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerning land-acquisition compensation relies on a judgment from another proceeding that is neither in the record nor brought into it, filing an application to introduce additional evidence does not make that judgment available for consideration.
